subject: Chemistry
title: Aldehydes Ketones And Carboxylic Acids - CBSE Official Practice DPP

questions.question:
Two statements are given below - one labeled Assertion (A) and the other labeled 
Reason (R). 
Assertion (A): In acetaldehyde, the carbonyl carbon acts as a Lewis acid and the 
carbonyl oxygen acts as a Lewis base.
Reason (R): Carbonyl compounds have substantial dipole moments. 
Which of the following is correct?
options: Both A and R are true, and R is a correct explanation of A.
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A.
A is true, but R is false.
A is false, but R is true.
questions.explanation: 14 (a) Both A and R are true, and R is a correct explanation of A.
